purpose: Retain every round-five formal performance and default-payload gate while admitting only the already approved explicit follow_titles=False MCP interface addition.

conflict.original_guard: The original validation compares mcp_tool_schema_sha256, mcp_instructions_sha256 and mcp_initialization_tokens across both runtimes.
conflict.required_resolution: The approved explicit opt-in changes schema bytes and their token count. Only that exact schema projection may differ; instructions must remain byte identical. Arbitrary hash or token-count differences are never accepted.
conflict.old_attempts: No original evaluator, workflow, binding, result, failed attempt or historical fixture may be rewritten by this addendum. The new namespace is prospective, not a retry route for an already claimed candidate.

interface_contract.exact_description_suffix:
follow_titles opts into one complete source-title hop from the first
        lexical page within an explicit project. It is disabled by default and
        cannot be combined with semantic or coverage. Compact and detailed
        replies both retain title_reference provenance when it is enabled.
interface_contract.projection: Require unique original tool names, the same ordered tools, precisely one new input property on recall_memory, exact approved property bytes as JSON values, and candidate description equal to baseline description plus the exact suffix. Delete only that property and restore only that description. The entire remaining ListToolsResult JSON value must equal v0.3.2, including all tool descriptions, required fields, defaults, output schemas, annotations and any other fields.
interface_contract.instructions: Preserve full actual instructions and require byte equality across baseline/candidate, every session and every worker.
interface_contract.strict_boolean_runtime: Existing approved interface tests must retain actual MCP rejection of non-boolean inputs; this certificate does not substitute schema metadata for runtime strictness.
interface_contract.default_recall: All formal recall calls omit follow_titles and must retain complete v0.3.2 native and actual MCP default payload equivalence.

certificate.generation_boundary: After the final combined candidate source commit is fixed and before the formal binding or fresh selection is published. This scope and the evaluator/tests/workflow must already be committed before generation.
certificate.observations: Use official SDK stdio initialize and list_tools against the exact published v0.3.2 and final committed candidate. Preserve complete serialized ListToolsResult and instruction strings, SHA-256 hashes, both cl100k_base/o200k_base initialization token counts, exact package/source identities and projection result. Do not call ingestion or recall or read benchmark query content. Assert the isolated database is not created.
certificate.binding: Commit the source-bound certificate before binding. The new evaluator registry includes the scope, certificate generator, both original and new runner/workflow/tests and certificate. The binding includes exact certificate bytes/hash/source identities. Every formal worker's actual full schema, instruction hash and true initialization counts must match its certified source label.
certificate.reported_cost: Retain all actual initialization counts and their candidate-minus-baseline deltas. Do not substitute baseline values, mask differences or remove initialization overhead from resource reporting.
certificate.failure: An incompatible schema, wrong dependency/source, missing or changed certificate, or failed projection aborts before retrieval. Preserve failed generation diagnostics; never overwrite an existing certificate.

formal_measurement_unchanged.datasets: Exactly original synthetic61 and public1015 regression data; no new questions or changed query orders.
formal_measurement_unchanged.rounds: Original four ABBA rounds and original per-configuration deterministic query shuffles.
formal_measurement_unchanged.invariants: All original complete native/MCP payload comparisons, exact source/metadata/token/character budgets, indexed-content and ingestion equivalence, cache-zero checks, call-ledger order/completeness, baseline runtime pins, reused helper bytes, dependency pins, same-host/boot requirements, resource measures and failure gates remain.
formal_measurement_unchanged.publication: Retain first-attempt hosted-only execution, exclusive binding-wide remote claim, exact workflow ancestry/publication identity, per-worker durable checkpoints, no replay of started/failed workers, preserved incomplete raw records and no automatic publication retry.
formal_measurement_unchanged.fresh_quality: This addendum grants no permission to change fresh selection, question exclusions, source algorithms, quality gates, common packing or comparator budgets. All fresh registrations must be frozen before metadata/content access as separately required.

verification: Artificial schema counterexamples must reject altered legacy fields/tool order, missing/duplicate tools, extra properties, required/default/type drift, incomplete or overbroad description projection, changed instructions, token/hash drift and stale source certificates. Preserve original evaluator tests and add static equivalence checks for the unchanged schedules, gate/resource logic and hosted claim/worker lifecycle. New tests and schema-only generation require the coordinator's CPU window; no retrieval is authorized by this registration.
